title: Evaluation Measures of Individual Item Fairness for Recommender Systems: A Critical Study
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It critically analyzes exposure-based fairness measures for individual items in recommender systems.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on the mathematical and empirical properties of fairness metrics in recommender systems.
